name: postgres_run_sql
description: Execute a raw SQL query against the PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_run_transaction
description: Execute multiple SQL statements as a single atomic transaction.

name: postgres_explain_query
description: Get the query execution plan for a SQL statement to diagnose performance.

analyze.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE (actually executes the query)

name: postgres_list_schemas
description: List all non-system schemas in the PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_list_tables
description: List all tables in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_describe_table
description: Get column definitions for a specific PostgreSQL table including types, nullability, and defaults.

name: postgres_list_columns
description: List all columns across all tables in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_indexes
description: List all indexes in a PostgreSQL schema with their definitions.

name: postgres_list_views
description: List all views in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_functions
description: List all stored functions and procedures in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_triggers
description: List all triggers in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_sequences
description: List all sequences in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_foreign_keys
description: List all foreign key relationships in a PostgreSQL schema.

name: postgres_list_constraints
description: List all constraints (primary keys, unique, check, foreign keys) in a schema.

name: postgres_select
description: SELECT rows from a PostgreSQL table with optional WHERE, ORDER BY, and pagination.

name: postgres_insert
description: INSERT a row into a PostgreSQL table.

name: postgres_update
description: UPDATE rows in a PostgreSQL table matching a WHERE condition.

name: postgres_upsert
description: INSERT or UPDATE a row on conflict with a specified column (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE).

name: postgres_delete
description: DELETE rows from a PostgreSQL table matching a WHERE condition.

name: postgres_get_table_row_count
description: Get estimated row counts for all tables in a schema, sorted by size.

name: postgres_get_database_size
description: Get the size of all databases on the PostgreSQL server.

name: postgres_get_table_sizes
description: Get total size (table + indexes) for each table in a schema, sorted largest first.

name: postgres_get_index_usage
description: Get index usage statistics — scans, tuples read, and tuples fetched for each index.

name: postgres_get_unused_indexes
description: Find indexes that have never been used (idx_scan = 0) — candidates for removal.

name: postgres_get_table_bloat
description: Find tables with high dead tuple counts that need VACUUM.

name: postgres_list_slow_queries
description: List slowest queries by average execution time using pg_stat_statements.

name: postgres_get_active_connections
description: List all active (non-idle) database connections with their queries.

name: postgres_kill_query
description: Terminate a specific database connection by its PID.

name: postgres_get_locks
description: List all blocked queries and the locks they are waiting for.

name: postgres_get_replication_status
description: Check PostgreSQL replication status — replica lag and sync state.

name: postgres_create_index
description: Create a new index on a PostgreSQL table (CONCURRENTLY by default).

columns.description: Column name or array of column names

name: postgres_drop_index
description: Drop an existing index from a PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_add_column
description: Add a new column to an existing PostgreSQL table.

name: postgres_drop_column
description: Drop a column from a PostgreSQL table.

name: postgres_list_roles
description: List all PostgreSQL roles and their privileges.

name: postgres_get_grants
description: List all table-level grants for roles in a schema.

name: postgres_grant_privileges
description: Grant SQL privileges on a table to a role.

name: postgres_list_extensions
description: List all installed PostgreSQL extensions.

name: postgres_enable_extension
description: Enable a PostgreSQL extension (e.g. pgvector, uuid-ossp, pg_trgm).

name: postgres_vacuum_table
description: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on a table to reclaim storage and update statistics.

name: postgres_reindex_table
description: Rebuild all indexes on a table (REINDEX TABLE).

name: postgres_schema_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Complete schema audit — table list, index counts, bloated tables, largest tables, and installed extensions in one call.

name: postgres_health_check
description: SUPER TOOL: Database health snapshot — version, connection states, total database size, and tables needing vacuum.

name: postgres_create_schema
description: Create a new schema in the PostgreSQL database.

authorization.description: Optional role that will own the schema

name: postgres_drop_schema
description: Drop a PostgreSQL schema, optionally cascading to drop all contained objects.

cascade.description: Drop all objects in the schema (default false)

name: postgres_create_table
description: Create a new table in PostgreSQL with specified column definitions.

columns.description: Array of {name, type, primary_key?, not_null?, default?} objects

name: postgres_truncate_table
description: Remove all rows from a PostgreSQL table without dropping it.

name: postgres_copy_to_csv
description: Export the results of a SQL query as CSV text using PostgreSQL COPY TO STDOUT.

name: postgres_create_user
description: Create a new PostgreSQL role/user with login credentials and optional privileges.

name: postgres_drop_user
description: Drop a PostgreSQL role/user.

name: postgres_alter_user_password
description: Change a PostgreSQL user's password.

name: postgres_nextval
description: Get the next value from a PostgreSQL sequence (auto-increments the sequence).

name: postgres_setval
description: Set the current value of a PostgreSQL sequence.

is_called.description: If true (default), next nextval will return value+increment

name: postgres_list_publications
description: List logical replication publications in the PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_list_subscriptions
description: List logical replication subscriptions in the PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_set_session_config
description: Set a PostgreSQL configuration parameter for the current session.

parameter.description: Config parameter e.g. search_path, timezone, lock_timeout

name: postgres_show_config
description: Show a specific PostgreSQL configuration parameter, or all settings if no parameter given.

parameter.description: Optional: specific parameter to show e.g. max_connections

name: postgres_get_wait_events
description: List all non-idle database sessions currently waiting on a lock or I/O event.

name: postgres_get_bgwriter_stats
description: Get PostgreSQL background writer and checkpoint statistics — useful for tuning I/O performance.

name: postgres_advisory_lock
description: Attempt to acquire a PostgreSQL advisory lock on an integer key (non-blocking). Returns acquired: true if the lock was obtained, false if it's held by another session. Use for distributed locking patterns — e.g. ensure only one worker processes a job at a time.

lock_key.description: Integer lock key (e.g. hash of a resource ID)

shared.description: Acquire shared (read) lock instead of exclusive

name: postgres_advisory_unlock
description: Release a PostgreSQL advisory lock held by the current session on the given integer key. Call this after your critical section completes to allow other sessions to acquire the lock.

name: postgres_notify
description: Send a NOTIFY event on a PostgreSQL channel with an optional payload string. Any sessions or applications running LISTEN on that channel will receive the notification in real time. Use for lightweight event-driven patterns like job queue signals or cache invalidation.

name: postgres_list_replication_slots
description: List all logical and physical replication slots on the PostgreSQL instance. Returns slot name, plugin, type, database, active status, restart LSN, and confirmed flush LSN. Use to audit CDC pipelines and check for slot lag.

name: postgres_create_replication_slot
description: Create a logical replication slot for Change Data Capture (CDC). The slot retains WAL data from its creation point so consumers can replay changes. Use pgoutput plugin for native logical replication or wal2json for JSON output.

plugin.description: Decoder plugin: pgoutput, wal2json, or pglogical

name: postgres_drop_replication_slot
description: Drop a logical replication slot by name. WARNING: dropping an active slot will cause the consumer to lose its position and may require a full resync. Only drop slots that are no longer needed or whose consumers have been shut down.

name: postgres_list_databases
description: List all databases in the PostgreSQL cluster with size and encoding info.

name: postgres_create_database
description: Create a new PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_drop_database
description: Drop a PostgreSQL database. Use force=true to disconnect active connections first.

name: postgres_rename_database
description: Rename a PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_change_database_owner
description: Change the owner of a PostgreSQL database.

name: postgres_get_database_config
description: Get non-default PostgreSQL configuration settings (from pg_settings).

name: postgres_create_role
description: Create a PostgreSQL role (group role without login by default).

name: postgres_grant_role
description: Grant a PostgreSQL role to a user or another role.

name: postgres_revoke_role
description: Revoke a PostgreSQL role from a user or another role.

name: postgres_revoke_privileges
description: Revoke table privileges from a role.

name: postgres_grant_schema_privileges
description: Grant schema-level privileges (USAGE, CREATE) to a role.

name: postgres_grant_all_tables
description: Grant table privileges on all tables in a schema to a role.

name: postgres_set_default_privileges
description: Set default privileges so future tables automatically grant access to a role.

name: postgres_alter_user
description: Alter a PostgreSQL user/role options (e.g. SUPERUSER, CREATEDB, CONNECTION LIMIT).

name: postgres_list_role_members
description: List all role memberships in the PostgreSQL cluster.

name: postgres_dump_schema
description: Export a PostgreSQL schema as SQL using pg_dump (schema-only, no data).

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the .sql file

name: postgres_dump_table
description: Export a specific table using pg_dump (schema + data or custom format).

name: postgres_get_query_stats
description: Get detailed query statistics from pg_stat_statements — calls, avg time, cache hit rate.

name: postgres_get_cache_hit_ratio
description: Get the overall buffer cache hit ratio for the database (target: >99%).

name: postgres_get_index_bloat
description: Identify over-sized or unused indexes that may be candidates for removal.

name: postgres_get_long_running_queries
description: Find queries running longer than a threshold in seconds.

name: postgres_get_missing_indexes
description: Find tables with high sequential scan counts that likely need indexes.

name: postgres_reset_statistics
description: Reset all pg_stat statistics counters for the current database.

name: postgres_analyze_table
description: Run ANALYZE on a table to update planner statistics.

name: postgres_cluster_table
description: Physically reorder a table's rows by an index to improve sequential scan performance.

name: postgres_list_available_extensions
description: List all available PostgreSQL extensions (installed and not-yet-installed).

name: postgres_drop_extension
description: Remove an installed PostgreSQL extension.

name: postgres_get_extension_info
description: Get version and description info for a specific PostgreSQL extension.

name: postgres_rename_table
description: Rename a PostgreSQL table.

name: postgres_drop_table
description: Drop a PostgreSQL table. Use cascade=true to also drop dependent objects.

name: postgres_rename_column
description: Rename a column in a PostgreSQL table.

name: postgres_alter_column_type
description: Change the data type of a column. Optionally provide a USING expression for conversion.

name: postgres_set_column_not_null
description: Set or remove the NOT NULL constraint on a column.

name: postgres_set_column_default
description: Set or remove the DEFAULT value on a column. Pass null to drop the default.

default_value.description: SQL expression or null to drop

name: postgres_add_primary_key
description: Add a PRIMARY KEY constraint to a table.

columns.description: Column name or array of column names

name: postgres_add_foreign_key
description: Add a FOREIGN KEY constraint linking one table to another.

name: postgres_add_unique_constraint
description: Add a UNIQUE constraint to one or more columns.

columns.description: Column name or array of column names

name: postgres_add_check_constraint
description: Add a CHECK constraint to a table with a custom SQL expression.

name: postgres_drop_constraint
description: Drop a constraint from a table by name.

name: postgres_create_view
description: Create or replace a PostgreSQL view or materialized view.

name: postgres_drop_view
description: Drop a PostgreSQL view or materialized view.

name: postgres_refresh_materialized_view
description: Refresh a materialized view to update it with the latest data.

name: postgres_get_function_definition
description: Get the source code definition of a PostgreSQL function or stored procedure.

name: postgres_drop_function
description: Drop a PostgreSQL function or stored procedure.

name: postgres_permissions_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Full permissions audit — all roles, table grants, role memberships, and schema privileges in one call.

name: postgres_performance_report
description: SUPER TOOL: Full performance deep-dive — slow queries, missing indexes, unused indexes, cache hit ratio, vacuum status, and blocking locks.
